course_name_original: Introducción a la mecánica de medios continuos

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and use of the principles of strength of materials.

syllabus_topics: Stresses and deformations in deformable media.
assessment_rules: The course uses continuous assessment. The written final exam (60%) and laboratory practice evaluation (40%) each require a minimum score of 4 out of 10. To pass, an overall average grade of 5 or higher is required. If any minimum grade is not met, the final course grade will be that of the final exam. Students can retake only the failed revaluable activities in the extraordinary call.
bibliography: Beer- Johnston. Mecánica vectorial para ingenieros. Estática y Dinámica. McGraw Hill
Oliver Olivalle, Xavier y Agelet de Saracíbar Bosch, Carlos. Mecánica de medios continuos para ingenieros. Universidad Politécnica de Cataluña
